label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
**Lee, what do you reckon to going halves on a dumper?**

I’ve been looking at that secondhand tracked dumper in Faversham. It’s a 2019, 500kg one, up for £1,650 ono. The bloke says it had new tracks fitted last spring. If we paid the asking price, that’s £825 each, and I can keep it under cover in my lean-to at the yard.

I know it’s a fair bit to put down, so I’ve had a look at what we’re spending on hire. We had the tracked dumper for 14 days this year at £85 a day, plus £30 delivery each time. All in, we spent roughly £1,600. So at that sort of use, buying one would cost about the same as another year’s hire, before servicing and repairs. Even if we only used it half as much, it’d be roughly two years before it paid for itself.

We’ve already got the three patio digs and the Boughton drive booked in for spring, so it’s not like it’d be sitting there doing nothing. And we’d have it when we need it, rather than working around the hire place. Remember that driver turning up at 11 and losing us half the morning?

Then there was Hernhill in September, when they didn’t have one at all. We ended up barrowing six ton of muck, it took us two extra days and your back was gone for a week. I’d rather not do that again.

I reckon we split servicing 50/50 and, if one of us breaks it, whoever broke it pays for the repair. If it doesn’t work out, we can sell it on and split what we get back. They seem to hold their value, although we’d have to see what it fetches.

Come and have a look at it with me this Saturday before someone else has it. We can check it over properly and see if it’s worth the money.
